_note: Experiment 3 advice (design v2, HANDOFF §0). DRAFT wording 2026-10-02, not yet approved by the user. rule and example are fixed per misconception; flag and correction are templates filled per trial with the first erroneous problem {problem}, its error step {step}, and that step's {right_pair} / {wrong_pair} from src/user/data/stimuli_exp3.json. Every example_expression is one the misconception gets wrong, and no pool problem uses it (checked by base-task/verify_stimuli_exp3.py).

templates.flag: You should look again at step {step} of problem {problem}.
templates.correction: In problem {problem}, step {step}, you should have done {right_pair} before {wrong_pair}.

add_before_mul.rule: You should do multiplication before addition.
add_before_mul.example: If you see 2 + 3 × 5, you should do 3 × 5 first.

add_before_div.rule: You should do division before addition.
add_before_div.example: If you see 4 + 8 ÷ 2, you should do 8 ÷ 2 first.

sub_before_mul.rule: You should do multiplication before subtraction.
sub_before_mul.example: If you see 9 - 2 × 3, you should do 2 × 3 first.

sub_before_div.rule: You should do division before subtraction.
sub_before_div.example: If you see 10 - 6 ÷ 2, you should do 6 ÷ 2 first.

same_priority_rtl.rule: When operations have the same priority, you should work left to right.
same_priority_rtl.example: If you see 9 - 4 + 2, you should do 9 - 4 first.

outside_bracket_first.rule: You should work out what is inside brackets first.
outside_bracket_first.example: If you see 2 + 3 × (4 + 1), you should do 4 + 1 first.
